description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Balance sheet at 30.04.2015
categorisation: This gazette content contains the Central Bank of Sri Lanka's balance sheet and financial statements as of April 30, 2015, including assets, liabilities, and a review report from the Auditor General. This falls under commercial matters as it deals with banking and financial institution reporting, making it a Commercial Gazette (Type 6) rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
